verdict.rationale: Plausible's single lightweight script, deployable via WordPress plugin or Google Tag Manager without touching code, captures pageviews automatically, including SPA pushState and hash routing. Vendor pages also claim automatic tracking of external link clicks, file downloads, form completions and scroll depth with no setup. Arbitrary custom events, however, still need explicit custom-event setup. Missing for 10: automatic capture of general element/button clicks beyond outbound links and downloads, form interactions beyond completions (e.g. field engagement or abandonment), in-depth docs on how auto form/click capture works, and independent hands-on corroboration.
